obligations.statement: The caller supplies an input of the stated structure with width > 0, start <= end, and fill either 'none' or 'previous'; no additional input bounds or preconditions apply.

acceptance_criteria: G = sort_scalar_lex(unique(map group events)).
Out-of-range-only and null-only groups remain in G.
The actual specified source universally refines this formula and satisfies all seven source facets.
obligations.statement: For every admitted input, let G be the sorted distinct set of group names from all events, including names appearing only outside [start,end). Group ordering compares Unicode scalar codepoints lexicographically. These and only these groups participate in bucket generation. The implementing source is program.vscore.json, solve of arity 1, with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.

acceptance_criteria: Bucket starts are exactly start+k*width for natural k satisfying start+k*width<end.
Intervals are lower-inclusive and upper-exclusive, with the last upper boundary clipped to end.
The actual specified source universally refines this formula and satisfies all seven source facets.
obligations.statement: For every admitted input and each group in G, generate exactly one bucket for each natural k with b_k=start+k*width < end, covering [b_k,min(b_k+width,end)). No buckets exist when start=end. The implementing source is program.vscore.json, solve of arity 1, with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.

acceptance_criteria: count(g,b)=|M(g,b)| and sum(g,b)=Σ values in M(g,b), preserving multiplicity.
All-null buckets have count 0.
Integer summation is exact, including negative and zero values.
The actual specified source universally refines these formulas and satisfies all seven source facets.
obligations.statement: For every group g and bucket start b, let M(g,b) be the multiset of event occurrences with group=g, b<=time<min(b+width,end), and value non-null. Count is |M(g,b)| and sum is the mathematical integer sum of their values. Each duplicate occurrence contributes independently; null values and out-of-range events contribute neither count nor sum. The implementing source is program.vscore.json, solve of arity 1, with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.

acceptance_criteria: count>0 implies value=sum and nextPrevious=sum.
count=0 implies nextPrevious=previous and value=(null if fill='none' else previous).
Before any nonempty bucket, previous is null; zero sums remain valid previous values.
Only earlier in-range nonempty buckets of the same group determine previous.
The actual specified source universally refines the complete recurrence and satisfies all seven source facets.
obligations.statement: For each group independently, initialize previous=null before its first bucket. For each ascending bucket, if count>0, emit value=sum and update previous to that sum, including zero. If count=0, emit null when fill='none'; when fill='previous', emit previous, which equals the sum of the latest strictly earlier nonempty bucket or null if none exists. Empty buckets leave previous unchanged. Events before start never seed previous, and state never transfers between groups. The implementing source is program.vscore.json, solve of arity 1, with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.

acceptance_criteria: Result equals the complete group-major, bucket-minor concatenation of the specified rows.
No missing, extra or reordered rows occur.
The actual specified source universally refines the full result formula and satisfies all seven source facets.
obligations.statement: For every admitted input, return exactly the concatenation, over G in Unicode scalar lexicographic order, of each group's ascending bucket rows {group:g,start:b,count:count(g,b),value:filledValue(g,b)} specified by O3–O5. Include one row for every group/bucket pair and no other rows. Empty events or start=end produce []. Preserve this exact structure and ordering through data-pipeline/0.3. The implementing source is program.vscore.json, solve of arity 1, with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.

Examples do not replace the universal formulas.
